# Typed

> Typed is a quiet, local-first workspace for notes, tasks, and money. Everything is a note — text, to-do lists, and finance records live in one plain-markdown store on your own device.

## What it does
- Notes with markdown editing, rendered preview, tags, [[wikilinks]], and full-text search
- Tasks parsed from markdown checklists (`- [ ]` / `- [x]`) with a structured checklist editor and an Android home-screen widget
- Finance: expense/income entries, budgets with alerts, category breakdowns, 14-day sparkline, honest multi-currency totals (dominant currency, never mixed sums)
- Reminders: evening recap, writing streak, budget alerts (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS)

## Privacy
Local-first: data stays on the device (SharedPreferences storage, JSON export/import backup). No accounts, no servers, no tracking.

## Platforms
Web (https://typed.shaheen.works/), Windows, macOS, Linux, Android.
